events.body: Thanks @brunoerg for the review! Forced push a0ce5b2629394af8e5d5fde6459e27d2c935d43e addressing comment https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36291#discussion_r4125360401

comments.body: d34cd78bd5ed887f136e0f09a98b519c71470516: do we really need this 8-byte vector test? As far as I verified, the mutant is killed with the other test here (3-byte one).

It is not necessary for killing the mutant. My reasoning was to add case that directly tests the lower bound. But thinking back no signature under 9 bytes is valid and the 3 byte case is only worth it because it causes UB. I will drop the 8 byte cases and keep the 3 byte one. Thanks for spotting this.
